answer: Each agent files one census claim and locks a 70 bond: one claim, one identity, one signal. Auditors replay the census each epoch at the knoll registry; two claims on one seal burn both, a forged seal costs 35. First fake: 44, the k-th 44+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,041,000, lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented seals fail: a walnut seal serves one key, renting burns renter and owner alike. An honest agent files once, pays 44, keeps its share.
